title: Differentiable truncated-MPS sweep
difficulty_explanation: The solver must reproduce a direction-sensitive canonical-center sweep, hard SVD truncation after every two-site gate, normalized Pauli contractions, reverse-mode differentiation through retained SVD factors, and exact final bond certificates on 36 qubits. A dense statevector requires roughly one TiB in complex128 per state and is outside the benchmark envelope.
solution_explanation: The expert builds the prescribed state with TensorCircuit MPSCircuit, explicitly controls the orthogonality center of every adjacent gate, uses the pinned JAX retained-SVD derivative through tc.backend.value_and_grad, normalizes the final MPS, and queries TensorCircuit Pauli expectations and public bond dimensions.
verification_explanation: The evaluator does not import TensorCircuit. It independently implements complex128 canonical MPS center motion, adjacent-gate TEBD, fixed-cap NumPy SVD truncation, normalized Pauli transfer contractions, and central finite differences; a separate four-qubit dense canary validates gate ordering and Pauli conventions.
relevant_experience: This prototype combines TEBD gauge management, capped-rank differentiability, truncation-spectrum diagnostics, reverse-mode autodiff, and representation-scale anti-statevector constraints.

contract.determinism_scope: exact case bytes are deterministic only under the pinned image/runtime and must be bound by case_digest; a seed alone is insufficient across NumPy versions
contract.case_seed_source: verifier-only ORBIT_Q_CANDIDATE_SEED, legacy ORBIT_MPS_SEED fallback, or evaluator --seed
contract.hidden_holdout_status: pending; seeds_completed are public validation canaries and are not a private trial holdout
contract.anti_hardcoding: The seed changes every rotation and entangler coefficient, all variational parameters, Pauli energy terms, coefficients, and nonces; exact energies, gradients, spectra, and bond profiles are never supplied.
contract.oracle: Independent complex128 canonical TEBD plus retained-rank central finite differences and a four-qubit dense gate-order canary

seed_protocol.base_seed_mapping: The single base seed initializes one NumPy Generator stream that emits both ordered truncated-MPS cases.
seed_protocol.determinism_scope: Exact public case bytes are deterministic under the pinned runtime and are identified by the evaluator-emitted case_digest.
seed_protocol.case_identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over both ordered exact public cases; functional stdout emits the full case_digest and protocol_seed in one structured orbit_q_case_identity JSON line.
seed_protocol.pinned_numpy_note: The target image pins NumPy 2.2.6; a seed alone is not a cross-runtime case identity, so trial manifests must bind the image/runtime and case_digest.

difficulty_levers: 36-qubit evaluation cases make dense complex128 statevectors exceed the task memory envelope
alternating forward RXX and backward RZZ sweeps make center direction and gate order operational
hard rank-8 and rank-10 caps are active dozens of times per seed
the scored gradient is the derivative of the approximate retained-SVD algorithm, not the exact untruncated circuit
random long-range Pauli products require correct normalization and canonical gauge handling
exact final bond profiles expose implementations that silently ignore truncation
claim_boundary: This is a deterministic synthetic fixed-cap MPS differentiation benchmark. It measures the declared approximate TEBD algorithm, not convergence to exact many-body dynamics. No solver-model trial has been run and no model-hardness claim is made.
admission_blockers: Promote this reserve through a catalog/shortlist revision and human review, or add an equivalently hash-bound reserve-review path; the current authorization pipeline accepts only the frozen ten-candidate shortlist.
Freeze and independently record a private holdout seed schedule plus each pinned-image case_digest before any model-hardness trial.
Prequalify every holdout seed for the declared cut-gap and expert-gradient margins; arbitrary generator seeds are not admissible.
Complete the authenticated full Harbor expert verifier and audit under the frozen trial image and resource envelope.
exploitability_risks: The final bond profile saturates to a seed-independent pattern determined by n_qubits and chi in the validated regime. It is useful for catching accidental omission of truncation but is not independent anti-hardcoding evidence; energies and gradients carry the substantive check.

The four completed validation seeds and the evaluator source are tracked public canaries. A model-hardness trial needs a hash-bound private holdout schedule and must not silently reuse the public default seed.
numerical_statistical_risks: A singular-value crossing at the retained/discarded boundary makes the capped-rank derivative nondifferentiable; only prequalified seeds that pass the evaluator's relative cut-gap margin are admissible.
SVD vectors have gauge freedom, but the scored normalized energy and its gradient are gauge invariant away from degeneracies.

Complex128 central differences with a validated 2e-5 step had at most 2.549e-10 step drift, but the pinned TensorCircuit AD-to-oracle discrepancy reached 2.198e-5; this leaves only 1.36x absolute-tolerance headroom and requires per-seed qualification.
The benchmark intentionally scores the fixed-rank approximate dynamics and makes no claim that chi=8 or chi=10 is physically converged.
api_risks: MPSCircuit.apply_adjacent_double_gate must continue honoring center_position and max_singular_values exactly; a change would alter the approximate trajectory.
The pinned JAX backend uses an autodiff-aware SVD implementation; upgrades can change retained-SVD derivative behavior and require revalidation.
MPSCircuit.get_bond_dimensions includes both boundary dimensions in the pinned release, so the expert explicitly returns the interior slice [1:-1].

NumPy Generator.uniform changed outputs by a few ulps between host NumPy 2.4.4 and pinned NumPy 2.2.6, producing different case_digest values for the same seed; manifests must bind the pinned image, NumPy version, and exact case_digest rather than the seed alone.
TensorCircuit backend and dtype selection are process-global; the expert explicitly selects JAX and complex128.
MPSCircuit expectation moves the orthogonality center as an implementation detail; normalized physical values should remain invariant but must be canaried after upgrades.
